title: Design System: SACC — Sana Al-Awael Contracting Company

referenceImplementation.note: Proposal 4, modern institutional, as the owner adopted it: contact action «تواصل معنا» (form «للتواصل»), no engineering line drawings, approving bodies by official logos on white plates, fleet page without an equipment count, Journey and Leadership as separate pages, certifications tabs ordered approvals, commitment, ISO.

teal-900.note: Masthead, inner-page head band, teal content bands, menu drawer, hero fallback ground.

teal-800.note: Selected filter fill, teal button, selected tab text, outline button text; tab counts on teal.

teal-700.note: More links, outlines, form sheet top rule, selected tab underline, milestone years, leader roles, teal button hover.

teal-600.note: Focus ring and caret on light grounds; every icon and tick on light grounds.

teal-100.note: Photo frame tint (loading or missing photograph), outline button hover, text selection.

orange.note: The contact action fill; on teal grounds the current-state markers (nav underline, drawer link, tab underline, ticks, feature icons, quote rule), focus ring and skip link.

ink.note: Headings and body on light grounds; text on the orange action.

ink-2.note: Secondary prose, section leads, filter text, tab counts.

ink-3.note: Meta, fact keys, unselected tabs, hints; field hover border.

on-teal-2.note: Secondary text and unselected links on teal.

white.note: Main ground, form sheets, inputs, logo plates.

mist.note: Alternate band ground, hover fill of ruled cells, tags, tab counts.

rule.note: Hairline between rows and cells; sheet border; logo plate outline on light grounds.

rule-strong.note: Firm top rule of lists, tab baseline, input and filter strokes, scrollbar thumb.

danger.note: Form errors and the failure notice.

declaredUnused.note: Every :root token is used. These rules in site.css match no shipped markup.

narrative.overview:
The site reads as the formal register of an established infrastructure contractor: orderly, contemporary and plain. White and a cool mist grey carry the content; the logo's deep teal frames it, as the utility bar, the sticky masthead, every inner page's head band, the approvals band on the home page, the chairman's quote and the footer. The logo's orange is held back for the one contact action, «تواصل معنا» in the masthead, and for the small markers that say "here" on a teal ground (the current page, the selected tab, a tick, a rule).

Everything sits on a hairline-ruled grid. Lists of comparable things (disciplines, scope of work, capabilities, values, milestones, project facts, office details, open roles) are rows between 1px rules, with a firmer rule on top and no fill. Cards are a photograph and a title, not a box. The field is shown only by the company's own photographs: one pinned under the home hero that the page slides over, and the photographs of real projects. Who approved the company is shown by each body's official logo on its own white plate. No line drawings, no ornament, nothing that moves except calm fades and colour changes.

Arabic is the root language and Almarai sets both scripts at 400, 700 and 800. The English twin under /en mirrors through logical properties; arrows flip with the reading direction.
keyCharacteristics: White and mist grounds; deep teal (#0d3536 / #0b2c2d) for the chrome and the key bands.
Orange only for the contact action and for small current-state markers on teal.
One family, Almarai, with 800 headings, 700 labels and 400 body at a generous 1.75 line height.
Hairline-ruled rows and grids instead of cards and plates; near-square 2px corners.
The company's own photographs only; approving bodies by their official logos on white plates.
Flat by default; two soft shadows only (the sticky masthead and the form sheet).

rules.name: The One Orange Action Rule
rules.body: Orange fills exactly one kind of button: the contact action. Elsewhere it is only a thin marker of current state on a teal ground, never a fill on white.

rules.name: The Teal Frame Rule
rules.body: Teal is the frame, not the content: chrome, page heads and at most one key band per page. Content bands are white or mist.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Almarai sets everything. Weight carries the hierarchy: 800 heads, 700 labels and list items, 400 reading text.

rules.name: The Two Shadows Rule
rules.body: Only the masthead and the form sheet cast a shadow. Anything else that needs separation gets a rule or a change of ground.

dos: **Do** set content on white or mist in ink, with ink-2 for secondary text and ink-3 for meta; teal-700 and teal-800 only for what is interactive or selected.
**Do** put comparable items in hairline-ruled rows: a 1px rule-strong top rule, 1px rule between rows, no fill.
**Do** keep corners at 2px and photographs square.
**Do** show the approving bodies only by their official logos, uncoloured, on white plates at an equal visual area.
**Do** open each inner page with the teal page head and give a page with several kinds of content tabs, keeping the certifications order: government approvals, commitment, ISO certificates.
**Do** use only the company's own photographs, in a teal-100 frame that holds when a photograph is missing.
**Do** write layout with logical properties and flip directional arrows with the reading direction.
donts: **Don't** use orange as a fill for anything but the contact action, or as text on white.
**Don't** add a second contact action to a page section; the masthead's «تواصل معنا» is the one route to the form.
**Don't** bring back the engineering line drawings; the owner removed them.
**Don't** state an equipment count on the fleet page.
**Don't** merge Journey and Leadership back into one page.
**Don't** add shadows beyond the masthead and the form sheet, or radii above 2px.
**Don't** add small labels or kickers above section headings.
**Don't** recolour, redraw or tint the SACC logo or any body's logo; the white wordmark sits on teal only.
**Don't** invent testimonials, certificate numbers, client logos or figures.
